class.name: CbGrip
class.brief_description: A marker for a hand. Not used yet: kept for hand placements to come.
class.description: Items do not use this node. Where the hands hold an item is said by the item itself: [member CbItem.carry_grip] and [member CbItem.other_grip] name two ordinary markers ([Marker3D]) in its scene. The node is kept for placing hands on things that are not carried: a ledge, a wheel, another player. It does nothing today.
